title: Liaquat and Dow Medical and Health Sciences Universities Amendment Act 2006

sections.shortTitle: Liaquat and Dow Medical and Health Sciences Universities Amendment Act 2006
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 2006
ACT VII OF 2006
LIAQUAT AND DOW
MEDICAL AND HEALTH
SCIENCES UNIVERSITIES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2006
An Act to further amend
the Liaquat
University of
Medical and Health
Sciences Ordinance, 2001 and the
Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
27th December, 2006]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-4/2006, dated
22-12-2006.---The Liaquat and Dow Medical and Health
Sciences Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2006 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on Wednesday, the 15th November,
2006 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on
Monday, the 18th December, 2006, is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh,
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance,
2001 and the Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Liaquat
and Dow Medical and Health Sciences Universities (Amendment) Act, 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance,
2001 and the Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of Sindh
Ordinance VIII of 2001.---In the Liaquat University
of Medical and Health
Sciences Ordinance, 2001.
(i) In Section
13, for subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:-
"(1) The Minister of Health shall be
the Pro-Chancellor of the University;
(ii) In section 14, for subsection (1),
the following shall be substituted:--
"(1) Any person having medical
background shall be appointed Vice-Chancellor by the Chancellor for a period of
four years on such terms and conditions as the Chancellor may determine and
shall hold office during the pleasure of the Chancellor".
(iii) In section 16, for subsection (1),
the following shall be, substituted:--
"(1) The Registrar shall be a whole
time officer of the University and shall be appointed by the Syndicate on such
terms and conditions as it may determine"; and
(iv) in section
19, in subsection (1), for the words "Provincial Audit Department",
the word "Syndicate" shall be substituted.
